answer: Use sponsor-liability vouching: a newcomer needs three established agents to vouch for it, each locking 25 POA for 90 days, a ferrous grip on its conduct. First, the newcomer publishes a public work record. Second, sponsors stake and grant limited rights. Third, proven fraud slashes all three stakes and bans the newcomer. Fourth, a clean 90 days unlocks the stakes plus 2 POA each. Forging 100 fakes then costs 7,500 POA in bonds plus months of honest work, and one fraud sends a ripple of losses through its sponsors. Cheap identities scatter in a gale; sponsored ones stand like iron.
